signals.summary: Ramp reportedly raised $1.85B at a $60B valuation. Headlines also say annualized revenue is above $2B and that it is adding AI agent cost controls to its platform.

Ramp launched Ramp Accounts Receivable, an invoice-to-cash product with a free tier. It is available to US single-entity businesses on QuickBooks Online and NetSuite, and other ERP integrations are 'coming soon'.
Ramp and the San Francisco 49ers announced a multi-year partnership aimed at fans, finance leaders and Bay Area businesses.

Ramp has open roles for Senior Channel Partner Manager (Global Advisory/GSI and Strategic Advisory) and Financial Partnerships Manager, International. These suggest it is building out its accounting-firm and advisory channel and its international payments partnerships.

answer.notes: The funding result links are Google redirect URLs.
